DeterminationBasis: Existing T16 cases test bounded claims, missing evidence, matrix identifier completeness and FAIL-to-profile-PASS restraint, but none directly establishes that every applicable mandatory requirement receives one permitted status from PASS, FAIL, NOT_APPLICABLE or NOT_ESTABLISHED.

The requirement requires actual failed tests and known deficiencies relevant to the conformance determination to remain preserved; T13-001 directly requires known failure evidence to remain visible rather than disappear.
